battery.old_GW_proposal_status: not automatically a primary superiority test; omnibus conditional rejection does not establish the same one-sided RMSE margin
battery.HLN_status: optional finite-sample proposal requiring functional-specific validation; h1 differs from sigma7 overlap

planning_simulation_contract.replicate_preserves: same temporal path and crossed seed dependence for all rivals and all3 procedures
planning_simulation_contract.null_validation: boundary and below-margin nulls, partial-null configurations, shared shocks, heavy tails, weak/nonstationary alternatives; validate size/FWER before power
planning_simulation_contract.marginal_decision: intersection of all3 Holm-adjusted procedures perrival, not anysinglemethod
planning_simulation_contract.joint_decision: same-replicate intersection across19 rivals; do not multiply marginal powers
planning_simulation_contract.Monte_Carlo_uncertainty: one-sided simultaneous Clopper-Pearson exact-binomial bounds over19 rival intersections; joint bound separate; independent simulation replicates required; Monte Carlo precision is conditional on an unvalidated DGP

pilot.kind: future separate planning-only pilot; no training launched here

pilot.budget_reference_formula: 300×120s/3600, excludes setup, HPO, classics, failed attempts and analysis
pilot.why_not_run: current scientific NO-GO, no admitted prospective planning/confirmation panels or validated battery; not lack of user willingness
